decisions: Docs follow the user-pinned Next.js, Angular, Linear, shadcn and Raycast references: 76px sticky shared masthead with search, grouped sidebar, 16px prose, contents rail and copyable framed code blocks.
OPTZ uses a slanted speed mark and geometric SVG wordmark. Yellow remains exclusive to artwork.
Trails continue ambient motion after arrival, with pause, reduced motion, visibility suspension and an understated request control.
All routes support device-aware light and dark themes, with a persisted explicit choice and browser-tab synchronization.
DIHLabs uses the supplied ring-and-slash mark and wordmark in the shared header and footer.
The main-site OPTZ product dropdown links to overview, docs and benchmarks; Escape returns focus and outside click or link selection closes it.
Docs sidebar becomes a native disclosure below 1024px; contents folds below 1280px; masthead search becomes full width at 800px.

decisions.name: Documentation evidence and code
decisions.description: Use accessible CSS-icon support states, zero-based benchmark charts sourced from checked-in JSON with provenance and exact-value disclosures, and build-time Shiki VS Code Light+/Dark+ syntax colors. Syntax token colors are confined to code; charts remain monochrome.
